description: This Java class defines the 'AclModified' event, which is emitted after a Thing's Access Control List (ACL) is modified. It includes methods for constructing instances, JSON serialization/deserialization, and comparison. The class is annotated as deprecated and immutable, and it extends a base event class, implementing event-specific logic for handling ACL modification events within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: AclModified
